name: Hermes-Agent
description: The self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research. The only agent with a built-in learning loop.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: The /opt/data volume is the single source of truth for all Hermes state. Must be owned by HERMES_UID:HERMES_GID (default 10000:10000). If you see permission errors after first run or after an upgrade, run on the host: chown -R 10000:10000 /mnt/cache/appdata/hermes-agent (the 'pairing' subfolder is the one that commonly breaks). Use a real disk path like /mnt/cache/... - on the /mnt/user FUSE share the container's ownership fix can fail to stick.

ports.name: Dashboard
ports.description: Port for the dashboard HTTP server

variables.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD
variables.description: Set to 1 (or true / yes) to launch the dashboard alongside the main command

variables.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_HOST
variables.description: Bind address for the dashboard HTTP server

variables.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_PORT
variables.description: Port for the dashboard HTTP server

variables.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Required password for the dashboard login. Use a strong password and keep the dashboard on a trusted LAN or VPN; do not expose it directly to the internet.

variables.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Optional but recommended signing secret so dashboard login sessions survive container restarts. Use at least 32 random bytes, for example the output of: openssl rand -hex 32. If left blank, Hermes generates a new secret at each start and existing sessions are signed out.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS
variables.description: Comma-separated user IDs allowed to use the bot (applies to DMs, groups, and forums)

variables.name: TELEGRAM_GROUP_ALLOWED_USERS
variables.description: Comma-separated sender user IDs authorized in groups/forums only (does NOT grant DM access). Chat-ID-shaped values (starting with -) are still honored as chat IDs for backward compat with pre-#17686 configs, with a deprecation warning.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_GROUP_ALLOWED_CHATS
variables.description: Comma-separated group/forum chat IDs; any member is authorized

variables.name: HERMES_GID
variables.description: Runtime group ID. Must be 1000-65534 - the image silently rejects lower values, so Unraid's default 100 (users) will NOT work and the container falls back to GID 10000. Leave at 10000 unless you need to match a host group >=1000. The appdata directory must be owned by this GID.

variables.name: HERMES_UID
variables.description: Runtime user ID. Must be 1000-65534 - the image silently rejects lower values, so Unraid's default 99 (nobody) will NOT work and the container falls back to UID 10000. Leave at 10000 unless you need to match a host user >=1000. The appdata directory must be owned by this UID. If you hit permission errors (e.g. 'Permission denied: /opt/data/pairing/telegram-approved.json'), fix ownership on the host: chown -R 10000:10000 /mnt/cache/appdata/hermes-agent
